table.retrieve:
SELECT
	Monthno=monthno,
	Month=month,
	OPENING=(SELECT SUM(V.DEBIT-V.CREDIT) FROM VIRTUALGL V, CUSTOMER C WHERE V.ACCCODE = C.CUSTCODE AND V.DATE < S.MINDATE),
	SALE=SUM(S.SALE),
	Ret=SUM(S.RET),
	NetSale=SUM(S.NETSALE),
	Receipts=SUM(S.Receipts),
	Debits=SUM(S.Debits),
	Credits=SUM(S.Credits)
FROM 
	(SELECT 
		Monthno=STR(DATEPART(year, M.Date)) + '-' + STR(DATEPART(month, M.Date)),
		Month=DATENAME(month, M.Date) + '-' + DATENAME(year, M.Date),
		MINDATE=CONVERT(DATETIME, RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(MONTH(M.DATE)))) + '-' + '01-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(YEAR(M.DATE))))),
		SALE=SUM(SALE),
		Ret=SUM(RET),
		NetSale=SUM(NETSALE),
		Receipts=SUM(Receipts),
		Debits=SUM(Debits),
		Credits=SUM(Credits)
	FROM
		(SELECT 
			Date=CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(varchar(10), T.Date, 101)),
			Sale=ISNULL(SUM(CASE T.TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN T.AMT ELSE 0 END), 0),
			Ret=ISNULL(SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'R' THEN T.AMT ELSE 0 END), 0),
			NetSale=ISNULL(SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN T.AMT WHEN 'R' THEN -(T.AMT) ELSE 0 END), 0),
			Receipts=ISNULL(SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'BC' THEN T.AMT ELSE 0 END), 0),
			Debits=ISNULL(SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'DR' THEN T.AMT ELSE 0 END), 0),
			Credits=ISNULL(SUM(CASE TYPE WHEN 'CR' THEN T.AMT ELSE 0 END), 0)
		FROM
			(SELECT
				Type='S',
				InvCode=H.SaleInvCode,
				Date=h.Date,
				Amt=Round(SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) +
				SUM(ROUND( (D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND( (SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * H.discperc)) -
					H.flatdisc) * (H.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
				Round(SUM((D.looseqty*(D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * H.discperc)) + 
					H.misccharges + H.salestax - H.flatdisc, 0)
			FROM
				saleledger h, saledetail d
			WHERE
				h.posted='Y' AND h.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
				h.salecatcode IN (2) AND
				h.saleinvcode = d.saleinvcode AND
				h.date >= :ad_startdate AND h.date <= :ad_enddate
			GROUP BY 
				h.saleinvcode,
				h.Date, 
				h.discperc,
				h.misccharges,
				h.salestax,
				h.flatdisc,
				h.invgstperc1
			UNION ALL
			SELECT
				Type='R',
				InvCode=H.SRInvCode,
				Date=h.Date,
				Amt=ROUND(
					SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
					SUM(ROUND( (D.looseqty * D.srprice) * 
						 (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
					ROUND( (sum( (D.looseqty * D.srprice) *
						 (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
						 (1- (.01 * H.discperc)) - H.flatdisc) * 
						 (H.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
				Round( sum( (D.looseqty * D.srprice) *
						 (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
						 (1- (.01 * H.discperc)) + H.misccharges + 

						 H.salestax - H.flatdisc, 0)
			FROM
				srledger h, srdetail d
			WHERE
				h.posted='Y' AND h.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
				h.SRCatCode IN (7) AND 
				h.srinvcode = d.srinvcode AND
				h.date >= :ad_startdate AND h.date <= :ad_enddate
			GROUP BY 
				h.srinvcode,
				h.Date,
				h.discperc,
				h.misccharges,
				h.salestax,
				h.flatdisc,
				h.invgstperc1
			UNION ALL
			SELECT 
				TYPE='BC',
				InvCode=0,
				Date=h.Date,
				Amt=SUM(D.Credit)
			FROM 
				Customer C, GlDetail D, GlHeader H
			WHERE
				H.VochCatCode IN (2, 4) AND
				H.Posted = 'Y' AND
				H.GlVochCode = D.GlVochCode AND
				D.AccCode = C.CustCode AND
				h.date >= :ad_startdate AND h.date <= :ad_enddate
			GROUP BY
				D.AccCode, h.Date
			UNION ALL
			SELECT 
				TYPE='DR',
				InvCode=0,
				Date=h.Date,
				Amt=SUM(D.Debit)
			FROM 
				Customer C, GlDetail D, GlHeader H
			WHERE
				H.VochCatCode NOT IN (2, 4) AND
				H.Posted = 'Y' AND
				H.GlVochCode = D.GlVochCode AND
				D.AccCode = C.CustCode AND
				h.date >= :ad_startdate AND h.date <= :ad_enddate
			GROUP BY
				D.AccCode, h.Date
			UNION ALL
			SELECT 
				TYPE='CR',
				InvCode=0,
				Date=h.Date,
				Amt=SUM(D.Credit)
			FROM 
				Customer C, GlDetail D, GlHeader H
			WHERE
				H.VochCatCode NOT IN (2, 4) AND
				H.Posted = 'Y' AND
				H.GlVochCode = D.GlVochCode AND
				D.AccCode = C.CustCode AND
				h.date >= :ad_startdate AND h.date <= :ad_enddate
			GROUP BY
				D.AccCode, h.Date
			UNION ALL
			SELECT 
				TYPE='BC',
				InvCode=0,
				Date=N.PostDate,
				Amt=SUM(N.Amount)
			FROM 
				Customer C, Notes N
			WHERE
				N.Posted = 'Y' AND
				N.AccCode = C.CustCode AND
				N.Postdate >= :ad_startdate AND N.Postdate <= :ad_enddate
			GROUP BY
				N.AccCode, N.PostDate) T
		GROUP BY
			CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(varchar(10), T.Date, 101))) M
	GROUP BY
		M.DATE) S
GROUP BY
	month,
	monthno, mindate
ORDER BY 
	monthno
